description: Read an rsID, CAid, ClinVar Variation ID or reference-qualified HGVS; chromosome notation requires --build. Use search variant --gene BRAF --protein V600E for shorthand. Every candidate remains available; source assertions do not classify the variant for the caller.

section.description: Named source sections; omitted by default. Each calls its own source. all keeps bounded pages and source skips; it never enables a missing key.

section_offset.description: Source rows to skip independently of identity candidate paging.
